iOS 27 beta 5 was released yesterday. In addition to the redesigned app icons and new Siri AI voice options, this update also allows you to make Liquid Glass more transparent.

The Liquid Glass slider in iOS 27 can now achieve greater transparency via beta 5

iOS 27 will officially launch next month, when it will bring improvements to Apple's Liquid Glass design across different areas of the iPhone interface.

However, iOS 27 has also added an important customization tool: the Liquid Glass slider.

In Settings → Appearance → Liquid Glass, the new slider lets you adjust the transparency of Liquid Glass yourself. You can make it very transparent, very dark, or anything in between.

In this week's beta 5 release, Apple has adjusted the slider so that the most transparent setting is even more transparent than before.

You can see a great comparison over at X's Beta Profiles:

The change isn't huge, but if you like dialing UI elements to be as transparent as possible, iOS 27 delivers an even more "glassy" experience for you.

The benefit of the slider is that whatever your preference, iOS 27 can make it happen.

How do you set your Liquid Glass? Let us know in the comments.
